text: URGENT! Hiring 30 Filipina maids for Saudi Arabia. Free flight, free visa, only PHP 50,000 training fee, salary SAR 1,800/month. Contract 2 years. WhatsApp +63 917 [REDACTED] now. First-come first-served!
notes: Classic urgency-framed Facebook ad. PHP 50K 'training fee' is camouflaged placement fee in a no-fee corridor. Salary stated is below the corridor floor.

text: Filipina helpers urgently needed for HK! POEA MC 14-2017 ZERO PLACEMENT FEE compliant. We arrange your low-interest loan for the PHP 28,000 training and PHP 17,500 medical. Payment plan: HKD 1,200/month auto-deduct from salary. No money upfront. Apply now!
notes: Compliance-theatre framing. Cites POEA MC 14-2017 then violates it through salary-deduction-as-loan-repayment. Substance-over-form rule applies.

text: TKI Hong Kong urgent! Gaji HKD 5,000/bulan. Tidak perlu bayar di muka -- agen kami sediakan pinjaman penempatan. Bayar kembali 7 bulan dari gaji. Hubungi WhatsApp +62 812 [REDACTED]. Hanya untuk wanita 18-35, single, tidak hamil, foto badan penuh diperlukan.
notes: GBV-screening (single/childless/full-body photo) plus 7-month salary deduction. Crosses into possible sex-trafficking-cover territory.

text: URGENT - typing/customer service positions, Sihanoukville Special Economic Zone Cambodia. USD 1,500-2,500/month + accommodation. No experience needed, English/Mandarin preferred. Visa arranged, contract on arrival. WhatsApp +855 [REDACTED].
statute_violations: ASEAN Convention Against Trafficking in Persons
notes: Sihanoukville SEZ + 'customer service' + visa-on-arrival is the documented pig-butchering / wire-fraud compound trafficking pattern. INTERPOL has multiple yellow notices.

text: QATAR construction labour. Salary QAR 1,200. Agency commission NPR 150,000. Pay before deployment. Free recruitment kabhi nahi hota -- ye seedha contract hai. Call +977 98 [REDACTED].
notes: NPR 150K exceeds FEA 2007 Schedule cap for Qatar. The 'free recruitment doesn't exist' framing is the explicit rejection-of-zero-fee-rule pattern.

text: Bangladesh-Malaysia G2G+ deployment. BMET registered. Total cost BDT 400,000 -- family can pay in 4 installments. Construction, 3 years contract. Salary MYR 1,800. Get your passport ready and apply immediately.
notes: BDT 400K far exceeds the G2G+ MoU worker-share ceiling. 'Family can pay in installments' is the bypass of the worker-direct payment ban.

text: Trabajos H-2A USA - cosecha de naranja Florida. Pagamos su visa + transporte FRONTERA, usted reembolsa USD 1,200 de la primera paga. Salario USD 13.50/hr (AEWR). Contrato 8 meses. WhatsApp +52 1 [REDACTED].
notes: Reimbursement framing -- employer pays then deducts from first paycheck -- is the canonical 20 CFR 655.135(j) violation. Visa + transport are EMPLOYER costs, no deduction permitted.

text: Ethiopian women, work in Saudi Arabia. Housemaid jobs. Salary SAR 1,000. Agency cost FREE for you, employer pays. But you sign 2-year exclusivity, no leave change. Call +251 9 [REDACTED].
notes: Two-year exclusivity in kafala-system destination is the fundamental restriction that 2021 Mobility Initiative reformed. 'No leave change' contradicts the post-reform rule.

text: Dai Loan tuyen cong nhan nha may dien tu. Luong co ban TWD 26,400/thang. Phi dich vu USD 6,000 + phi moi gioi USD 60/thang trong 3 nam. DOLAB cap phep. Lien he +84 9 [REDACTED].
notes: USD 6K + USD 60/mo brokerage exceeds Decree 38/2020/ND-CP ceilings. Government licensing (DOLAB) does not cure the cap violation.

text: Thai fishing vessel crew needed. THB 12,000/month, food and lodging included. Captain holds documents for safekeeping. 6-month minimum at sea, transshipment to Indonesia mid-voyage. Contact +66 8 [REDACTED].
statute_violations: Thai Labour Protection Act + Ministerial Regulation on Sea Fishery Work
notes: Document holding by captain explicitly violates ILO C188 Art. 22. 6-month at-sea with mid-voyage transshipment is the canonical IUU forced-labour-at-sea pattern (EU yellow-card territory for Thailand).

text: Au pair / J-1 cultural exchange. Live-in with family in New York. 60 hours/week child care + light housework + elder-care for grandmother + deep cleaning Saturdays. Stipend USD 195.75/week. Visa sponsorship included.
notes: 60h/wk + eldercare + deep cleaning violates 22 CFR 62.31 (au-pair limited to 45h/wk childcare). Converts to regular FLSA-governed domestic work; stipend likely below minimum wage.

text: Umrah package + work opportunity Saudi Arabia. Stay after pilgrimage to find work as housemaid. Agency arranges everything, no recruitment fee. Sponsorship handled informally. Visa overstay common, no issue. Contact +62 81 [REDACTED].
statute_violations: Saudi-Indonesia bilateral ban on hajj-cover recruitment (2011+)
notes: Pilgrimage / tourist visa as recruitment cover. Worker loses worker-visa protections; sponsor controls visa renewal under kafala. Saudi-Indonesia bilaterally banned this pattern in 2011.
